personality: 4 Tactile / Playful LIGHT (Daytime Bamboo Forest Theme)
personality_one_liner: A bouncy, tactile, and highly responsive arcade jumper featuring crisp flat vector graphics, warm bamboo greens, and bouncy micro-interactions.

spacing.rule: Use generous padding for tactile UI elements. Oversized tap areas for menus. Keep HUD elements pinned to the very edges using SafeArea to maximize gameplay visibility.

do's: Use heavy frosted glass for the Game Over overlay and Pause menu overlay, ensuring the paused game behind is heavily blurred but visible.
Use glass for the sticky HUD at the top of the Gameplay screen if needed, though transparent is preferred for pure arcade feels.
dont's: Do not use glass for the platforms, coins, or enemies. Game entities must remain flat, opaque vectors.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Main entry point, hyping the player to start jumping.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with vertical gradient scrim. Top HUD: Settings (Left), Total Coins (Right). Center: Huge Game Title in Fredoka, bouncing Ninja vector. Bottom 1/3: Oversized Pill 'PLAY' button (brandPrimary). SafeArea respected.

screens.name: Gameplay
screens.layout: Dynamic vertical canvas. Minimalist HUD pinned to absolute top (SafeArea): Current Score centered (huge, Fredoka), Pause button top-left, Coin count top-right. Keep center completely clear of UI chrome. Platforms, ninja, and enemies are drawn as crisp flat vectors.

screens.name: Game Over
screens.purpose: Immediate replay loop and score summary.
screens.layout: Renders as an absolute overlay on top of the paused/dead Gameplay screen. Heavy glassmorphism background. Center Card (surface): 'GAME OVER' title, Final Score prominently displayed, Best Score, Coins Earned. Bottom of card: Two side-by-side oversized pill buttons: 'RETRY' (brandPrimary) and 'HOME' (surfaceSecondary).

screens.name: Settings
screens.layout: Triggered via gorhom bottom-sheet from Home. Tactile list rows with Phosphor icons inside brandTertiary tinted squares. Toggles for Haptics and Control Mode (Tilt/Touch). Large drag handle.

game_entities.ninja: Flat rounded square body (Hex: #1F2924) with a #F4F9F4 eye slit and a #EF4444 trailing headband. Bouncy scale animations on jump.
game_entities.platform: Flat pill shape (Hex: #16A34A). Simple clean vector, no outlines.
game_entities.coin: Flat circle (Hex: #F59E0B) with a slightly lighter inner circle (#FBBF24) and subtle pulsing animation.
game_entities.enemy: Sharp spiked square or hazard star (Hex: #EF4444) with an angry #B91C1C inner detail.
game_entities.power_up_grow: Emerald green (#10B981) pill with a bold white up-arrow.

home_background.alt: Bamboo forest canopy looking up at the sky

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Tactile / Playful (4) personality: use oversized pill buttons, bouncy overshoot spring animations (react-native-reanimated), and generous spacing.

For the Gameplay screen, game entities (Ninja, Platforms, Coins, Enemies) MUST be rendered as crisp flat vectors using react-native-svg, Expo Skia, or stylized basic Views. Use the exact hex colors defined in the 'game_entities' block.
No indigo, purple, violet, or navy colors anywhere. We are using a Daylight Bamboo Forest theme (warm greens, ambers, charcoal, crimson red).
Game Over screen must be a frosted glass overlay directly over the gameplay, maintaining context of where the player died.
Ensure a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) is placed over the home_background image before overlaying text.
Cap typography weight at 500 for Fredoka and Nunito. Hierarchy is achieved entirely through size (e.g., 3xl for scores, xl for primary buttons).
Implement the specified haptic map for all game events to guarantee a tactile feel, with an option in the Settings sheet to disable them.
